findings.description: candidate.py and placement.py use UNKNOWN_VERSION as fallback when workflow target version is missing, but this should be enforced at intake rather than silently accepted. Add schema validation in Wave 3 to reject candidates without proper version binding before placement logic runs.

contracts_store dictionary loses contracts on server restart, breaking immutability guarantees across deployments. Replace with persistent storage (database, Redis, or file store) in Wave 3 to maintain contract hash integrity in distributed environments.
